title: Usual
summary: U'SUAL, adjective s as z. Customary; common; frequent; such as occurs in ordinary practice, or in the ordinary course of events. Rainy weather is not usual in this climate. Consultation with oracles w

inlines.v: U'SUAL, adjective s as z. Customary; common; frequent; such as occurs in ordinary practice, or in the ordinary course of events. Rainy weather is not usual in this climate. Consultation with oracles was formerly a thing very usual
